create_collectives_instance: create a Collectives instance from a DeviceMesh for distributed tensor operations with optional custom allreduce
split_tensor_locally: split a tensor along dimension 1 across devices in the collectives group using local_split
all_gather_tensors: gather tensors from all ranks in the group and concatenate them along a specified dimension
all_reduce_tensor: perform an all-reduce operation on a tensor using custom allreduce or NCCL fallback
capture_collectives_context: use the capture context manager to record collective operations for replay with custom allreduce
